note: Small GFP recreation area on Flat Creek Lake, beside Shadehill Reservoir 12 mi S of Lemmon off SD-73: one loop of back-in electric sites in a shelterbelt, the lake in view through the trees. Vault toilets and drinking water only; showers and the dump station are at Shadehill Recreation Area. Picnic shelter, shore fishing, primitive boat ramp. --Claude
